most_relevant.description:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Visiting the IIT Bombay campus during the monsoon is an unforgettable experience. The lush green surroundings, rain-soaked trees, peaceful lakes, and fresh air make the campus look like a paradise in the heart of Mumbai. Every corner feels vibrant and full of life, with beautiful architecture blending seamlessly into nature. Walking through the tree-lined roads while enjoying the cool drizzle is incredibly refreshing. The campus is well-maintained, serene, and offers the perfect balance of academic excellence and natural beauty. A must-visit place during the rainy season for anyone who appreciates peaceful and picturesque landscapes.
Visited to attend to my daughter's post graduation ceremony at the 64 th convocation. Visited the Industrial Research Centre and the auditorium. Also had apeek into the VR lab. Everything was Great.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ IIT Bombay, Powai
A sprawling green campus tucked beside Powai Lake — peaceful, beautiful, and surprisingly self-contained. Peacocks roam freely like they own the place (they probably do). World-class labs, a buzzing food court, and infrastructure that puts most small towns to shame. The academic energy is intense but the tree-lined walks balance it out perfectly. Monsoon transforms the whole place into something almost magical. Getting in as an outsider needs prior permission, which is a minor hassle. But if you ever get the chance to spend a day here, take it without thinking twice. One of Mumbai’s most underrated gems.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

Visited IIT Bombay during Techfest, and honestly it was just…decent. For something that’s supposed to be the #1 institute in India, the experience didn’t really match the hype. They call it the “biggest techfest in Asia,” but even the projects and exhibitions were not exactly mind-blowing for a claim that big. A lot of it felt fairly normal rather than futuristic or genuinely impressive. If you’re branding it at that level, people are obviously going to expect way more.

One major issue was the management. There was a meetup with Kalki’s director where people had to wait in line for hours. When entry finally started, the hosting itself was quite underwhelming not very clear or engaging. And then, out of nowhere, there was a power cut in the auditorium for around 45 minutes, which was honestly surprising for a place of this level. It felt awkward overall, especially considering the guest and the expectations.

That said, the campus itself is big, green, and well maintained, and the library is impressive. But the event experience didn’t really live up to the reputation they promote.

It’s a memorable moment to enter into this IIT. It’s been a 5-month-long journey of NEC, and after that we secured the 156th rank in the Basic Track of the NEC Challenge, which itself is a proud achievement for us—especially because my college is new to these kinds of national-level challenges. Stepping into IIT Bombay after this journey felt unreal and deeply satisfying.

Attending E-SUMMIT 2K25 at IIT Bombay was nothing short of inspiring. From the moment we entered the campus, the environment itself motivated us to think bigger, dream bolder, and work harder. The infrastructure, innovation culture, and energy of the place clearly show why IIT Bombay is a global hub for entrepreneurship and technology.

The sessions, speaker talks, startup showcases, and interactions with entrepreneurs and mentors were extremely insightful. Listening to founders, investors, and industry leaders share their real-world experiences gave us clarity on how ideas turn into impactful startups. The exposure we gained here cannot be measured in words—it reshaped our mindset towards problem-solving, leadership, and innovation.

For a student coming from a college that is still growing in such ecosystems, this experience was truly empowering. Representing our institution at such a prestigious platform and standing among students from top colleges across the country gave us confidence and motivation to aim higher. The coordination, hospitality, and professionalism of the E-SUMMIT organizing team were excellent, making the entire event smooth and memorable.

Overall, IIT Bombay E-SUMMIT 2K25 was not just an event for us—it was a life-changing experience. It strengthened our belief that with consistency, teamwork, and vision, even students from new colleges can compete, learn, and grow on national platforms. This journey will remain a milestone in our academic and entrepreneurial life, and IIT Bombay will always hold a special place in our hearts.

⭐ Truly an unforgettable experience and a dream destination for every aspiring innovator and entrepreneur

The IIT Bombay campus immediately stands out for its scale, greenery, and how well maintained it is. Despite being massive, it feels calm, structured, and easy to navigate.

Once inside the campus for the summit, the experience became even more impressive. Internally, the event was very well organized...clear directions, smooth coordination, and volunteers who actually knew what they were doing. You could tell that a lot of people were working seriously behind the scenes to make the summit run smoothly.

The startup expo and network arena were the strongest parts of the summit. They felt purposeful rather than crowded or random, and the interactions were meaningful. The overall vibe was energetic but controlled, which is rare for events of this scale.

From my experience, the summit didn’t feel rushed or poorly managed at any point. The infrastructure of the campus supported the event well, making movement, networking, and participation comfortable throughout the day.

Overall, the combination of a well-run internal summit and a disciplined, well-kept campus made the experience genuinely positive and worth attending.

A recent visit to Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT Bombay) was both nostalgic and intellectually enriching, an experience that beautifully blended personal connections with meaningful academic engagement.

The reunion provided a platform where conversations naturally flowed across friendship, policy discourse, and reflections on evolving career pathways. Engaging discussions at the Ashank Desai Centre for Policy Studies added depth to the visit, offering fresh perspectives and thoughtful insights into contemporary policy challenges.

Equally memorable were the simple moments, revisiting familiar spaces, sharing a relaxed dinner, and reconnecting with old friends. These experiences brought back a sense of belonging while reinforcing how time may pass quickly, but meaningful relationships and ideas continue to evolve and strengthen.

Overall, the visit was not just a reunion, but a thoughtful pause, combining learning, reflection, and the enduring value of shared journeys.

It's always a great feeling to be in IIT Mumbai Campus & attend AI Seminar by ISD.
